title: One Finance business event (v1)
description: The single contract every source system (Motif, GMIS, RAMP, SAP, Axiom, US Castle, Finance Store, Helix) publishes to the Event Hub. Producers state facts about their own identifiers; the hub translates them into business identifiers and decides what the fact means for business outcomes.

eventId.description: Producer-assigned unique id. Re-sending the same id is a no-op (idempotent). If omitted, the hub derives a deterministic id from eventType + sourceSystem + sourceKey + cobDate + region + status.

eventType.description: Governed name from the event catalogue (BRD section 9).

sourceKey.description: The source's own identifier for the unit of work: master book, cost centre, batch, feed, schedule or report id.

cobDate.description: Close-of-business date the event belongs to (not the wall-clock date it was sent).

region.description: Processing scope. Outcomes are tracked per (outcome, cobDate, region).

status.description: COMPLETED counts toward readiness. FAILED blocks the outcome until a later COMPLETED for the same key. REVOKED withdraws a previous completion (restatement or re-run) and pulls readiness back from every dependent outcome.

occurredAt.description: When the fact happened at source (UTC). Defaults to receipt time.

attributes.description: Optional context. Downstream completions must echo correlationId and runId from the command they received so stale runs can be ignored.
